activities.Activity: Review Week 1 deliverables: draft influenza case definitions from the Epidemiologist, the EHR data dictionary, and current data collection status to scope the statistical analysis plan (SAP).
Draft SAP outline: objectives, target measures (weekly ILI encounter counts, test-positive proportions), and candidate time-series methods.
Lunch

Draft time-series methodology section: compare Serfling/cyclical regression, Poisson and negative binomial GLMs with harmonic seasonal terms, and CUSUM/EARS-type methods; document selection criteria suited to a small hospital population.
Draft epidemic threshold detection logic: baseline season definition, expected weekly counts, one-sided upper confidence/tolerance limits, and alert rules for consecutive-week exceedance.
Draft initial list of data quality and completeness metrics: field-level completeness, validity of dates and coded values, duplicate rate, and reporting timeliness.
Compile open questions for the Data Analyst and Epidemiologist and prepare the agenda for Tuesday's alignment meeting.
